TC-20/S20b.title: Real iOS and Android builds: wrong date / time zone shows the same counts; screen reader announces a count change
TC-20/S20b.detail: Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Gate TFA-92598 (in progress) and our addition: recorded only. Phone one day ahead in Pacific/Honolulu (re-signed in through its form after the clock change) vs the desktop on the real clock: identical Hospital counts (3 / 1 / 1 / 1) and Nursing Home counts (3 / 2 / 1 / 0) with the same residents listed - including the resident taken off In Today, on both devices (that is known B25, not a clock effect). TalkBack is installed on the image, and the count list is an aria-live='polite' region in code, but whether TalkBack actually speaks the change was not captured (no speech output on the emulator): left for a person with TalkBack / VoiceOver on.
